departments.name: Admin
departments.description: Coordinates documentation, schedules, permissions, budgets and overall planning across Taqneeq.
responsibilities: Manage documentation, schedules, permissions and budgets
Track progress across every department
Maintain records through preparation and execution
Keep coordination running between all teams

departments.name: Artist & Guest Management
departments.description: Coordinates invited speakers, judges, performers, influencers and artists from invitation through on-ground support.
responsibilities: Extend invitations to speakers, judges, performers and artists
Manage communication with invited guests
Coordinate travel, accommodation and hospitality
Provide on-ground assistance during the fest

departments.name: Digital Creatives
departments.description: Creates digital branding, social posts, motion graphics, banners, advertisements and website assets.
responsibilities: Design social media posts, banners and advertisements
Create motion graphics and website assets
Maintain a consistent digital visual identity

departments.name: Film & Media
departments.description: Photographs, films and edits the festival to document events, promotions and behind-the-scenes moments.
responsibilities: Photograph and film events, competitions and behind-the-scenes moments
Edit visual content for release
Curate photos and videos for social media and promotion

departments.name: Hospitality
departments.description: Ensures participants, guests, judges, sponsors and volunteers have a comfortable and welcoming experience.
responsibilities: Manage registrations and help desks
Arrange refreshments and accommodation support
Assist participants, guests, judges and sponsors on the ground

departments.name: Informals
departments.description: Creates games, interactive activities and audience-engagement experiences that add energy to the festival.
responsibilities: Design games and interactive activities
Run audience engagement sessions
Create informal events alongside the main competitions

departments.name: In-house Creatives
departments.description: Designs physical branding, stage backdrops, standees, posters, props, decoration and venue signage.
responsibilities: Design stage backdrops, standees, posters and props
Plan venue decoration and signage
Build physical installations across campus

departments.name: Logistics
departments.description: Plans, procures and manages venues, transportation, equipment, inventory, vendors and resources.
responsibilities: Plan venue setups and equipment requirements
Arrange transportation and manage inventory
Coordinate vendors and allocate resources

departments.name: Marketing
departments.description: Builds strategies and campaigns to increase reach, registrations, brand visibility and engagement.
responsibilities: Build promotional campaigns that drive registrations
Run market research and audience analysis
Plan collaborations that extend the festival's reach

departments.name: Outreach
departments.description: Builds relationships with colleges, student communities, organisations and external partners to expand participation.
responsibilities: Build relationships with colleges and student communities
Establish collaborations with external organisations
Promote the festival to students at other institutions

departments.name: Publicity
departments.description: Drives offline visibility through publicity drives, posters, banners, campus promotions and creative campaigns.
responsibilities: Organise publicity drives and campus promotions
Manage poster and banner placement
Execute offline campaigns that build awareness

departments.name: Social Media & Content Writing
departments.description: Creates captions, scripts, blogs, announcements and social campaigns while maintaining Taqneeq's online voice.
responsibilities: Write captions, scripts, blogs and announcements
Run social media campaigns across platforms
Maintain a consistent voice for the festival online

departments.name: Technical Events
departments.description: Conceptualises and builds hardware/software exhibits, interactive installations and technology showcases.
responsibilities: Conceptualise hardware and software exhibits
Build interactive installations and demonstrations
Run hands-on technical showcases for visitors

departments.name: Technicals
departments.description: Builds and maintains websites, registration portals, automation, dashboards, databases and technical infrastructure.
responsibilities: Build and maintain the website and registration portal
Develop automation, dashboards and databases
Provide technical support across the festival

departments.name: Workshops
departments.description: Builds educational collaborations, negotiates partnerships and organises workshops and seminars.
responsibilities: Identify and approach partners such as TEDx and Under 25
Negotiate and finalise collaboration deals
Manage collaborations on the day of the fest
Organise and host internal workshops and seminars
